s.en: show / manipulate network device hardware shaping configuration

syn: netshaper [ OPTIONS ] { COMMAND | help } ⏎ OPTIONS := { -V[ersion] | -c[olor] | -help } ⏎ netshaper set dev DEV handle scope HANDLE_SCOPE [ id HANDLE_ID ] bw-max BW_MAX ⏎ netshaper { show | delete } dev DEV handle scope HANDLE_SCOPE [ id HANDLE_ID ]

o.en: Print the version of the netshaper utility and exit.

Configure color output. If the parameter is omitted or always, color output is enabled regardless of stdout state. If the parameter is auto, stdout is checked to be a terminal before enabling color output. If the parameter is never, color output is disabled. If specified multiple times, the last one takes precedence.
